column5: THE CARRIED NOTE REPRODUCES AND THE COMPONENT HALF IS BUILT, in skai-gaming 933ed7ab. The brief told this lane to measure the 5.71 itself rather than build to the note, so it was re-derived from the raster rather than copied: the header fill is 1200x1700, covering a 32x32 square scales it by max(32/1200, 32/1700) = 32/1200, and that draws 32 x 45.3333 - which IS the board's own declared width 100% height 141.67%, so object-cover picks the right SIZE and only the offset is wrong. Centred, its top is (32 - 45.3333) / 2 = -6.6667px = -20.833%; the two instances the slots lane read live (11930:35966 at 375, 10745:19312 at 1440) lay it at -2.99% = -0.9568px. Delta 5.7099px on a 32px square, so the note is CORRECT to the digit - recorded plainly because the standing rule is that a carried note is a lead, and this one survived being checked. ★ WHY THE PROP IS FOUR NUMBERS AND NOT AN object-position, which is the part the note did not derive: for Vegas alone object-position WOULD close it, at 50% 7.176%, because the zoom already matches. Sugar rush's board lays its fill at 106.25% x 142.3% where a cover of the same picture draws 100% x 133.9%, and no object-position expresses a zoom. So PlayGameTitleRowProps takes the whole box, the shape SlotHeaderArt already carries, and a slot page passes its constant straight through. ★ ONE NUMBER THE HAND-OFF DID NOT ACCOUNT FOR AND THIS LANE HAD TO SOLVE: an absolutely positioned child resolves percentages against the PADDING box, and this square's 1px stroke leaves that at 30x30, so the board's percentages would have landed 141.67% of 30 = 42.5 where the frame draws 45.333 - a fix that shipped its own 2.8px error. The image sits in a layer at inset-[-1px], which is the border box, so the percentages resolve against the frame's own 32. CLOSED AT EVERY WIDTH WHILE THIS PASS WAS STILL OPEN: the call sites are the slots lane's, and that lane wired both against this sha - Vegas c2f1c8c8, Sugar rush eabd343e - and records the close in its own file. Verified here rather than taken on report: VegasFortunePage.tsx:146 passes artBox={VEGAS_HEADER_ART.box}, and 19 files / 211 tests are green across both pages' suites and this lane's shared directory at that HEAD. 375 is unaffected - it draws through SlotPhoneHeader, which has carried the box since wave 61. Tests: playGameTitleRowArtBox.test.tsx, five cases, MUTATION-TESTED both ways - reverting the square to object-cover reds two cases, and changing the layer to inset-0 reds the stroke case. 44 green across the three title-row suites; scoped tsc over both edited files, zero errors. Committed, not pushed, not deployed (Ruling 16); no browser measured it.

SAME COMPONENT FIX, SAME sha 933ed7ab, and this is the frame that decided the prop's SHAPE. Its desktop icon 10758:20844 was read live by the slots lane at left -3.13%, top -11.3%, width 106.25%, height 142.3%. Re-derived here rather than carried: a box of 106.25 x 142.3 percent of 32 is 34 x 45.536, an aspect of 0.7467, and object-cover on a source of that aspect draws 100% x 133.9% from (0, -17.0%) - wrong in BOTH axes, not just the offset. That is why artBox is {left, top, width, height} and not the object-position that would have been enough for Vegas alone, and it is the case that would have been missed by building to the Vegas half of the note. The 2.8px padding-box error described in the row above bites harder here: 142.3% of 30 is 42.69 against the frame's 45.536. CLOSED AT EVERY WIDTH BY THE SLOTS LANE IN eabd343e, against this sha. GemSlotsPage.tsx is outside this lane's owns (the owns list names Play.tsx, playGameArt.ts, playSectionOrder and playCatalogue in that directory, not the directory), so the wiring was never this lane's to do; :96 now passes artBox={GEM_HEADER_ART.box} and was read here rather than taken on report. ★ ONE THING THAT CAME BACK AND IS WORTH KEEPING: that lane's first oracle walked UP TWO LEVELS from the image to reach the square, which passes today and breaks the next time the wrapper moves. It now uses closest('.size-8'), which asserts the square in BOTH branches - an assertion keyed to DEPTH is an assertion about this commit, not about the board. 375 closed in wave 60 through SlotPhoneHeader and is untouched. ⚠ NOT RECONCILED AND DELIBERATELY NOT BUILT: this square draws a 1px border-green-coal-100 (#123F3C) and neither board INSTANCE carries a border, while the game-page boards the row was originally measured against (baccarat 9799:16719, keno 9433:12193, blackjack 9003:119191) all DO - playGameTitleRowResolved.test.tsx asserts it flat at all three widths. So the stroke is a per-board difference, not a component defect, and removing it would regress ten pages to close two; it needs its own prop and its own reading of the slot page MASTERS, which nobody has re-read since wave 60. Named here rather than guessed.

THE TWO REAL RESIDUALS ARE RE-CONFIRMED AND BOTH STILL HOLD, neither of them geometry. (a) The platform-average comparison and its bar fractions have no source - gaming_my_recent_rounds is bound to auth.uid() and returns the caller's rows only, so a cross-user aggregate needs a new definer read and supabase/ is fenced; the board's own three bars read 48.6, 8 and 44 of 188 against values 2.4%, 0% and 4, which is sample layout and not a mapping, so deriving the bars from the player's own figures would be a fabrication in the shape of a comparison. (b) The 100x32 "All time" control is a time-window filter over a rollup that takes no window, so it would be a dead control. ⚠ STILL UNMEASURED AND STILL FLAGGED RATHER THAN CLAIMED: the hairline colour is carried off the panel's own green-coal-100 stroke token and its vector fill 11096:108294 has never been read; this pass did not spend a Figma read on it either, because thirty-one lanes share one seat and a hairline does not close the frame.
